messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick sync 2h ago we got 3 support tickets: customers seeing marketplace billed units that don't match our entitlement logs. Looks like mapping between marketplace 'units' and our token model is ambiguous for some plans.

ashley_cs: Example from ticket: customer paid for 'Standard-100k' plan via Marketplace, received invoice showing 102345 units, but our redemption logs show 100102 tokens consumed. They hit us asking why they were pushed to overage.

hao_platform: Do we have a deterministic conversion table from marketplace units -> token_units? I thought plan SKUs map to multiplier but maybe some legacy SKUs are different.

jlee: We do, but there are two problems: (1) marketplace reports sometimes include pre-quantized 'units' (rounded) vs our internal raw token counts, and (2) some partners report seat-based consumption (seats * hours) that we previously treated as tokens.

eng-billing-bot: Alert: marketplace-reconciliation job:month-2026-02 produced 47 reconciliation alerts (diff > 0.5%) at 2026-03-02T09:03:11Z.

devon_finance: For customer-facing fallout we need a repeatable heuristic. Proposal: normalize marketplace units into our token model by using provider_metadata.conversion_type: {"FULL_TOTAL","SEAT_HOURS","DELTA"}. If FULL_TOTAL use provider-provided multiplier; if SEAT_HOURS compute tokens = seats * hours * plan_multiplier; if DELTA sum deltas. Also thresholding: if difference < 0.75% treat as rounding noise.

maria_partnerships: Good. I'll ask marketplace contacts to set conversion_type in their payloads or include a plan_sku field that we can map. Can we also ask for a 'finalized' boolean on month-end reports so we don't adjust after invoices are generated?

jlee: Implementation notes:
```sql
-- quick audit: list top mismatches by plan
SELECT m.customer_id, m.plan_sku, SUM(m.units) reported_units, SUM(u.tokens) internal_tokens
FROM marketplace_reports m
JOIN usage_redemptions u USING (customer_id, plan_sku, DATE_TRUNC('month', m.usage_window_start))
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY (SUM(m.units)::float - SUM(u.tokens)) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
We'll add a provider_metadata.conversion_type field to provider_registry and apply conversion at ingest time. For backfill, run a per-month re-normalization and produce credits via the billing pipeline.

ashley_cs: Operational ask: when we credit customers, we should auto-create a ticket draft and add the partner in CC if the marketplace requires co-communication. Also we should include a short explanation template: 'Your marketplace report used X units which maps to Y tokens on our side, discrepancy Z due to rounding/aggregation.'

devon_finance: Credit policy: auto-credit up to $250 for diffs <1% without manual review. >1% and <3% -> finance review. >3% -> revops + legal. We'll need to surface dollar impact in the reconciliation report.

hao_platform: Edge case: late-arriving 'correction' reports that update previous month's totals. If partners send corrections, we should accept them only if they have report.finalized = false OR if they include correction_reason. Otherwise ignore for billing after invoice cutoff.

maria_partnerships: I'll draft email to AWS/Azure PMs requesting: plan_sku, conversion_type, finalized flag, and correction_reason for adjustments. I'll cc revops.

eng-billing-bot: Job kickoff: marketplace-normalize-and-backfill started by jlee at 2026-03-02T10:12:05Z (job id: mb-normalize-20260302). Progress updates will post to this thread.

jlee: Action items summary:
- add conversion_type to provider_registry + normalize at ingest (ETA 8h)
- run backfill for Feb & Jan, generate reconciliation CSV w/ dollar deltas (ETA EOD)
- integrate finalized/correction flags into ingestion validation (ETA tomorrow)
- ashley_cs + devon_finance: prepare credit templates and policy doc (ETA EOD)

maria_partnerships: Thanks all 20: let's keep this thread updated and pull in revops if we hit >3% customers.
